symbols.name: negacyclic ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of polynomials in y with r complex coefficients, modulo y^r+1.
symbols.quote: It orders the outputs of the [synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) over $\mathcal R_r=\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$, polynomials in $y$ with $r$ complex coefficients, normed by the largest coefficient modulus.

symbols.name: number of rounds
symbols.meaning: The number of rounds, log base 2 of the transform length t.
symbols.quote: Let $t$, the transform length, be a power of two dividing $2r$; put $a=\log_2t$, the number of rounds, and $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$.

symbols.name: forward synthetic transform
symbols.meaning: The forward length-t synthetic transform on t ring elements.
symbols.quote:
For $z\in\mathcal R_r^t$ and $0\le j<t$,

$$(F_t^-z)_j=\frac1t\sum_{k=0}^{t-1}\omega_t^{-jk}z_k,\qquad (F_t^+z)_j=\frac1t\sum_{k=0}^{t-1}\omega_t^{jk}z_k.$$

symbols.name: bit-reversal record permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation moving the entry at j to rev_a(j).
symbols.quote:
Let $B_t$ be the permutation moving the entry at $j$ to $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$ <cite data-source="paper">Let $B_t$ denote this record permutation: it moves the entry at $j$ to $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$.</cite> The pointwise product keeps this order <cite data-source="paper">retain the same frequency order through their pointwise product</cite>.

The opposite procedure runs the levels backwards.

symbols.name: bit reversal
symbols.meaning: The map reversing the a binary digits of j.
symbols.quote: After $a$ rounds $(F_t^-z)_j$ sits at slot $\operatorname{rev}_a(j)$, where $\operatorname{rev}_a$ reverses the $a$ binary digits of $j$.

symbols.name: completed rounds
symbols.meaning: The number of rounds completed so far.
symbols.quote: After $s$ rounds slots $a-1,\dots,a-s$ hold frequency bits $0,\dots,s-1$ and the rest index a sequence of length $t/2^s$; the next round writes bit $s$ into slot $a-1-s$.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: Index of an axis of the array.
symbols.quote: With several axes, indexed by $i$, a round applies $H_0$ on every participating axis: one parallel butterfly $\mathcal H$.

symbols.name: current axis length
symbols.meaning: The current length of axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $u_i$ be axis $i$'s current length and $b_i$ its new bit.

symbols.name: new bit
symbols.meaning: The bit newly written by the latest round on axis i.
symbols.quote: Let $u_i$ be axis $i$'s current length and $b_i$ its new bit.

symbols.name: twiddle index
symbols.meaning: The number formed by the bits in axis i's unprocessed slots below the paired slot, with 0<=k_i<u_i/2.
symbols.quote: Its twiddle is $y^{-2rb_ik_i/u_i}$, where $k_i$ is the number formed by the bits in its unprocessed slots below the paired slot, so $0\le k_i<u_i/2$.

symbols.name: parallel butterfly
symbols.meaning: The operation applying H_0 on every participating axis at once.
symbols.quote: With several axes, indexed by $i$, a round applies $H_0$ on every participating axis: one parallel butterfly $\mathcal H$.

symbols.name: recordwise monomial
symbols.meaning: The operation multiplying the record at each address by y^E.

symbols.name: combined exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of y by which the record at an address is multiplied, determined by that address.

symbols.name: odd part
symbols.meaning: The odd part of j, so j=2^v j_0.
symbols.quote: For $t\nmid j$ write $j=2^vj_0$ with $j_0$ odd and $0\le v<a$.

symbols.name: two-adic exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of 2 in j, with 0<=v<a.
symbols.quote: For $t\nmid j$ write $j=2^vj_0$ with $j_0$ odd and $0\le v<a$.
